deterministic_issues.claim: I bring strong cloud and networking expertise, with hands-on experience in AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, and DNS/BGP infrastructure, supported by AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate and Cisco CCNA certifications. I have a proven ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and have maintained a 95% customer satisfaction score in prior support roles, reflecting my commitment to service excellence. While I do not hold a PhD in Computer Science or a CKA certification, I believe my practical experience and customer-focused engineering approach would allow me to add immediate value in this role.

judge_issues.claim: Proven track record in technical customer-facing roles, including onboarding enterprise clients, leading escalations, and delivering technical workshops
judge_issues.explanation: The facts support being technical point of contact for three enterprise customers during onboarding and escalations (R1.B3) and running customer workshops (R2.B4), but not 'leading' escalations.

judge_issues.claim: Led migration of 120 services from on-premise VMware to AWS, completed within 14 months, minimising downtime and aligning with customer timelines
judge_issues.explanation: The migration, service count and 14-month duration are supported (R1.B5), but 'minimising downtime' and 'aligning with customer timelines' are added outcomes not present in the facts.

judge_issues.claim: Run the company's Kubernetes platform (EKS) serving 40 internal engineering teams, providing a stable foundation for customer-facing applications
judge_issues.explanation: The EKS platform and 40 internal teams are supported (R1.B1); the framing that it provides a foundation for customer-facing applications is an added, unsupported characterisation.

judge_issues.claim: Participated in a weekly on-call rotation for production incidents, resolving critical platform issues impacting customer services
judge_issues.explanation: Weekly on-call participation is supported (R1.B4), but 'resolving critical platform issues impacting customer services' adds a scope and impact not stated in the facts.

judge_issues.claim: Delivered customer-facing technical workshops for business broadband clients, improving service adoption and satisfaction
judge_issues.explanation: The workshops are supported (R2.B4), but the resulting improvement in adoption and satisfaction is an invented outcome.

judge_issues.claim: Designed and maintained BGP and DNS infrastructure for a regional ISP network, ensuring high availability for customer connectivity
judge_issues.explanation: BGP/DNS design and maintenance for a regional ISP is supported (R2.B1); 'ensuring high availability for customer connectivity' is an added outcome not in the facts.

judge_issues.claim: Managed Cisco routers and firewalls across 12 data centre sites, supporting secure and reliable customer network operations
judge_issues.explanation: The Cisco routers/firewalls across 12 sites are supported (R2.B2); the 'secure and reliable customer network operations' framing is added colour not evidenced in the facts.

judge_issues.claim: My work in building reusable Terraform modules and CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions has standardised deployment practices across the company, improving reliability and developer velocity
judge_issues.explanation: Company-wide use of the Terraform modules and pipelines is supported (R1.B2), but the claimed improvements in reliability and developer velocity are invented outcomes.

judge_issues.claim: I serve as the technical point of contact for three enterprise customers during onboarding and incident escalations, ensuring smooth integration and rapid resolution of technical issues
judge_issues.explanation: The point-of-contact role is supported (R1.B3); 'ensuring smooth integration and rapid resolution' is an added outcome claim.
